sar.narrative: On 2016-12-29, customer C11923 disputed transaction 3583368 on card C11923-K2, stating, "I never made this $131.30 purchase. Please check my card." The episode consists only of transaction 3583368 and has total exposure of $131.30. The transaction was conducted online through a card-not-present channel. It used a device marked New for this account. The merchant details and transaction location were not provided in the available facts. The activity is linked to a 3-card device profile that also included connected cards C03938-K1 and C05595-K1. Two other cards transacted on the same device profile within 6 hours at near-identical amounts. The pattern identified was card_not_present_new_device, with a fraud probability of 0.88. This is suspicious because the customer denied making the purchase, the transaction occurred online using a new device, and the same device profile was associated with similar activity across multiple cards in a short time window.
